title: Akiyama Mizuki — A Moment's Rest〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it looks like no one else is here this today...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll find somewhere to sit over there.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade's song reminded me that I'd felt what I did when I heard her song... A long time ago...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Like when I ate apples that time...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There's no way for me to verify that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I needed to write it down so I wouldn't forget.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She kept saying, I don't know, like a broken record, but she felt compelled to find a way to not forget.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She was able to move forward just like Ena and Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess this also means that she was able to nudge open that door Luka was talking about a little.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Express anything I feel honestly...
I don't know if I can actually do that, but I'll try...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll try drawing something. I don't know if it'll be any good, but I'll try.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I was able to compose that song because you helped me open my eyes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Still...
What if I do any and it doesn't go well...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Ever since that mystery tour we went on, I keep going back to the same exact thing.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I just keep arriving at the same answer...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mind if I sit next to you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You usually sit next to Mafuyu like this whenever she comes here, right, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Here, I can tell her that she isn't all alone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Does that mean you want to tell me the same thing...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Miku?
Can you keep this just between us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is it about what's bothering you...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you need me to, sure.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right, we're supposed to meet here today. Time to get back up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see... Aha, there they are!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why are you the one rolling out the welcome wagon?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's something on your cheek, Ena. Did you fall asleep on your desk?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, it's not what you think! Quit pulling my leg!
